E0 glotan teams? or are they the same? idk

E0 is mostly a keyflare bot because her realm gives +2k keyflare at battle start and the first card from each awakener gives (team averagex3+100, better generation teamwide to the point where you can ignore an unit that actually is skey focused such as Ramona) good keyflare. In arc2 you need keyflare to Rouse, and the realm she brings makes posse take effect on rouse, so instead of splitting your keyflare you can do both for up to 4 turns.

She can be used as a dps with e0 in very new accounts just because her base numbers are the highest ever, but when the enemies hp gets high enough that you need to actually crit/play multiple cards/exalt for dmg she requires atleast e2 for consistency

You can slap e0 into whatever as a pseudo keyflare bot just because her realm is that good, but DPS glotan requires vuln, card draw and strength generation (which is why ryker is a premium support for her, since he gives those and even makes her crit more often/harder)
